$comment: config/tsconfig.base.json — the ONE TypeScript configuration for the platform.
2026-08-30. Apps extend this instead of carrying their own. The reason, measured:
FIVE DIFFERENT TARGETS existed across fourteen satellites — es5, ES2017, ES2020,
ES2022, and one repo with no target at all. Nobody CHOSE es5; it was inherited
from whatever template each repo started from, and it cost javari-games 22 type
errors because its engines iterate Maps and Map iteration needs ES2015 or higher.
That is the config-copying problem in one line: 98 repos each owning a framework
configuration means 98 edits for every framework decision.
then add only paths and include, which are genuinely per-app.
noImplicitAny is ON. javari-realty turned it on deliberately on 2026-08-21 and
that decision surfaced 135 real errors including a service-role key travelling in
a URL query string. Checking off is how those survive.
